config.purpose: test whether real RFM groups differ more than random groups with the same activity mix, not only the same head count
config.method: shuffle the real cluster labels only inside each activity stratum, so every stratum keeps the real label counts

A2_discovery_baskets.role: supplementary: matches the number of Discovery baskets per group; uses Discovery activity only to build the null groups, never the clustering

comparison.category_pool: all 2- and 3-category combinations with at least 20 joint Discovery baskets overall (independent of any grouping)
comparison.fixed_budget: C strict_increment5pp config (support>=3%, joint/antecedent>=20, confidence>=50%, lift>=1.5, 3-category increment>=5pp), budgets 20/50/100, largest-remainder quota by Discovery baskets
